snippet.title: Call of Duty Frontlines FOREVER | The EPIC Realism / Hardcore Experience EVER | THIS IS WAR!
snippet.description:
Released on 01.Oct.2018 @ https://www.moddb.com/mods/frontlines

WINNER : Best Call of Duty MOD of 2018 @ MODDB MOTY 2018 (Editors and Players Choice)

To play right now type in console this: /connect war.hajas.org

Call of Duty Frontlines is a huge mod for COD4 with the first release in 2008. In 2009 was elected by the famous on that time FPS site BashAndSlash.com as the Best COD mod, where received the nickname of "EPIC".

Call of Duty Frontlines FOREVER Main Features

. War Server with battlefields up to 3999 territories
. 46 Brand New Gametypes (52 in total!)
. Airborne Mode in ALL gametypes lets you be a paratrooper falling from the sky
. Help Mode, in which you play a realistic freeze-tag game in any team-based gametype
. Random Objectives changing each round with MILLIONS of combinations
. AI Soldiers! Deadly and Smart Bots playing all game types and modes, using all weapons
. Co-op Missions
. HER with realistic Blood, Gore, Pain, Damage & Physics effects
. Medic System with a Medic Perk to let you save your wounded teammates
. Over 2400 Weapon Modes combinations, with 16 pre-defined modes
. 4 Different Support Strikes (Tactical Airstrike/Heavy Bombing Strike/Artillery Strike/Mortar Strike)
. Intelligent Server which admins the server for you the way you want
. Intelligent Anti-Camping System coded for each gametype
. Frontlines Weapons, brand new balance and even single-shots!
. 170 Ranks to Level up with Custom Classes + Create-A-Class INGAME
. Frontlines Duel, where the last 2 will dispute the round with knives
. Real Bomb Squads
. Multi-Language Support for ANY language you speak
. Thousands of other features and options to let you do whenever you want

After more than 10 years of hard work and LOTS of tests at Blood Culture, it seems the impossible dream has come true! The most complete & diverse FPS game ever created is even greater!

With 52 Gametypes, Forever Concept with Random Objectives providing millions of combinations in each round, Stars & Medals System, over 2400 weapons modes, War Server which transforms a server into a amazing War, Medic System, Help Mode which is a realistic version of the famous Freeze-Tag which here is not a gametype, but an add-on to ANY team-based gametype, Real Bomb Squads, Paratroopers option with Airborne Mode in ALL gametypes, Hardcore gameplay with realistic damage, blood, gore, physics and of course war effects that will make you feel like you're in the middle of a real war. AI Soldiers, Deadly and Smart Bots playing all gametypes, modes using all weapons, making it possible to play Coop Missions with your friends in automatically adapted gametypes like  in Black Frontlines.

Beyond all these highlights we have the previously known Intelligent Server, which admins the server with all these countless features for you 24/7 without the need for human interaction, and really lots and lots more! Call of Duty Frontlines Forever is not just the biggest FPS game ever made, it's HUGE! To give you an idea, If you sum ALL multiplayer features of ALL the Call of Duty games released until today, and put it all in a single COD release, you still will not reach even 10% of what Frontlines has become. That's why Frontlines got the nickname EPIC in reviews.

The Global WAR Server interconnects ALL Frontlines servers around the world, which makes it possible to play World Wars with players from all over the world in a way never done before! Be part of this huge move in FPS history! It's time to EVOLVE!

Hajas Mods @ www.mods.hajas.org
Blood Culture @ www.BloodCulture.com.br
